description:
Are you a lover of exquisite, handcrafted jewelry? Do you find joy in discovering and sharing quality fashion with your circle? If so, we're delighted to extend an exclusive invitation for you to join us on a captivating journey. We are "The Littl," a brand synonymous with finely crafted jewelry that tells a story of elegance, class, and charm.

The Littl is more than just a jewelry brand; we're a community that celebrates the beauty of creativity, the artistry of handcrafted excellence, and the radiant individuals who wear our pieces. By joining our Brand Ambassador Program, you become an integral part of our story, contributing to a larger narrative of craftsmanship and style.

Why Join the Brand Ambassador Program?

As a Brand Ambassador, you have the privilege of sharing The Littl’s magic while enjoying fantastic perks. Our program offers a unique opportunity to engage with your audience, promote beautiful products, and earn a rewarding income.

💎 Earnings: Our Ambassadors are valued, and we believe in sharing our success. For every referral you make that results in a purchase, you receive a minimum of 10% of the revenue. As your referrals increase, so does your potential income.

💎 Exclusive Access: As an Ambassador, you get exclusive access to our latest creations before they hit the market. Be the first to showcase our new collections and offer your followers sneak peeks into our exciting launches.

💎 Special Deals: Enjoy special deals and discounts exclusive to our Ambassadors. The more you share, the more you can save on your favorite pieces.

💎 Networking Opportunities: Connect with a passionate community of jewelry lovers and influencers in the industry. As a part of The Littl family, you'll join a network that offers mutual support and inspiration.

Becoming a brand ambassador for The Littl is about embracing your style, expressing yourself, and inspiring others through beautifully crafted jewelry. You'll get the chance to work with a brand that values its ambassadors, cherishing the unique voices that help us tell our story.

If you're excited to start this journey, we're thrilled to have you on board. Welcome to The Littl Brand Ambassador Program—where we shine brighter, together!

Join us, and let's create beautiful stories, one stunning piece of jewelry at a time.
term_and_condition: By joining The Littl Affiliate Program, you agree to the following terms. Commissions are earned on first-time customer orders only - returning customers do not qualify. Our cookie window is 24 hours, meaning the customer must purchase within 24 hours of clicking your link. Commissions are calculated on the product sale amount only (excluding shipping, taxes, and discounts), are subject to a 30-day holding period, and require a minimum $50 AUD balance before payout. All commissions are manually reviewed and we reserve the right to deny, withhold, or reverse any commission at any time if the referral was not genuine, the customer was not new, or the sale originated from our own marketing channels (Google Ads, SEO, email, social, or direct traffic). You may only promote The Littl through your own social media posts, genuine blog content, word of mouth, and email to your own opted-in audience. The following activities are strictly prohibited and will result in immediate termination and forfeiture of all pending commissions: running paid ads (Google, Meta, TikTok, or any platform) that bid on or target "The Littl" or any variation of our brand name; posting affiliate links or discount codes on coupon aggregator sites (including Honey, RetailMeNot, OzBargain, wowocoupon, or similar); submitting manual referral claims for orders you did not genuinely refer; purchasing through your own affiliate link; using cookie stuffing, forced clicks, auto-redirects, or any method to artificially place tracking cookies; sending spam or unsolicited messages containing your link; making false claims about our products; or registering domains or social accounts that impersonate The Littl. Under Australian Consumer Law, you must clearly disclose your affiliate relationship in every piece of content (e.g. #ad, "affiliate link") - this is a legal requirement. All brand assets remain our property and must be used only as approved. We actively monitor traffic sources, order attribution, paid search auctions, and coupon sites to verify referral legitimacy. We may terminate your participation at any time, for any reason, with or without notice - upon termination all pending commissions are forfeited and you must remove all affiliate links and brand assets within 7 days. We may modify these terms, commission rates, cookie windows, or any aspect of the program at any time. These terms are governed by the laws of New South Wales, Australia. By participating, you confirm you have read and agree to these terms. For questions, contact hello@thelittl.com.
